sourceRefs.locator: Introduction, opening paragraphs through note 4. Odoacer in 476, the eastern emperor Zeno’s mandate, the Italian campaign in 489, the agreement and killing in 493, and Theoderic’s death in 526.
Pars posterior 53–56. Camp in the Pineta, reported price of a measure of wheat, difficulties during the siege, entry into Ravenna and Odoacer’s death.

summary.de: Der Heerführer setzte 476 Romulus Augustulus ab. Odoaker regierte in Italien als König und trat mit dem Kaiser in Konstantinopel in Verbindung. Theoderich tötete ihn 493 in Ravenna.
summary.en: The military commander deposed Romulus Augustulus in 476. Odoacer governed Italy as king and dealt with the emperor at Constantinople. Theoderic killed him in Ravenna in 493.
